small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 33%: split the BLOCK_OC×BLOCK_SPATIAL=32×64 tile into something like 16×64 or 32×32, and cap registers via `maxnreg=64` or fewer warps. Add a triton.autotune over (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SPATIAL, num_warps, num_stages) ∈ {(16,64,4,2),(32,32,4,2),(16,128,4,2),(32,64,8,2)}. Also fuse the BN affine + spatial-mean subtraction directly into a single epilogue kernel and drop the cudnn BN call (fold running_mean/var into scale/shift at forward entry).
large_guidance: Rewrite ConvTranspose3d as an input-driven scatter-add: one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) loads x[n,ic,id,ih,iw] once and scatters x*w into the OC×KD×KH×KW output positions using atomic adds (or per-(kd,kh,kw) accumulation since output positions are disjoint when stride>=kernel along strided axes — here stride=2,kernel=3 overlap only by 1, can still use atomics). This eliminates the current gather's redundant validity math and the (KD*KH*KW*IC)=432-trip inner loop with mostly-masked-out loads (only ~1/8 of positions are valid due to stride=2). Alternatively, cast as an im2col-GEMM where output is reshaped to (N, OC, OD*OH*OW) = M=OC, N=OD*OH*OW, K=IC*KD*KH*KW with the gather of x done implicitly per (kd,kh,kw); use BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=16, channels_last layout for coalesced K-loads. Fuse BN-folded scale/shift and the per-(N,OC) spatial-mean subtraction into the same epilogue (two-pass: first kernel writes conv+BN output and per-(N,OC) partial sums; second tiny kernel finalizes mean and subtracts).
